note: Project B preregistration. world.py, splits.py and instruments.py are hashed BEFORE scripts/qualify_world.py runs, which is the whole defence against the circularity a review identified in the first design draft ("if adaptive is no better than constant, redesign the world"). That instruction is deleted. The model and the train/dev/test seeds are fixed first, the preregistered thresholds are written down first, and whatever the gate returns is the result. Model version 1.1.0: v1.0.0 failed and tracing why exposed an independently statable realism defect -- capability was independent of the strategic environment, so defence networks scored the same whether the US was committed or gone. v1.0.0's failing numbers are kept in the record rather than discarded. Any further coefficient change requires a defect statable without reference to which arm it favours, a version bump, and a full rerun.
